title: Tomato Outdoor Girl - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Outdoor UK Tomato
description:
2x Outdoor Girl Organic Tomato Plug Plants (Mini Plugs) – Early Cropping, Ideal for UK Outdoor Growing


 You will receive 2 x mini plug plants of the Outdoor Girl tomato variety, ready for potting on and growing.


 Product details:
 

 Quantity: 2 mini plug plants
 

 Variety: Outdoor Girl (organic heritage variety)
 

 Plant type: Cordon (indeterminate)
 

 Planting time: April – June (weather dependent)
 

 Position: Suitable for outdoor growing or containers


 About the variety:
 

 Outdoor Girl is a reliable, early-fruiting tomato variety well suited to UK conditions, including cooler and variable climates. It produces crops earlier than many other varieties and performs well outdoors without the need for a greenhouse.


 Plants produce small to medium-sized red fruits with a balanced sweet and slightly acidic flavour. Fruits typically ripen around 2–3 weeks earlier than average varieties and are suitable for salads, cooking, or preserving.


 This variety has been awarded the RHS Award of Garden Merit (AGM) for consistent performance and quality.


 Growing information:
 

 Best grown as a cordon (pruned) for optimal airflow and yield
 

 Can be grown unpruned as a bush, though this may increase risk of disease
 

 Suitable for growing in open ground or containers
 

 Early to set fruit with good yields under typical UK conditions


 Fruit characteristics:
 

 Colour: Rich red
 

 Size: Small to medium (approx. large cherry to small standard tomato)
 

 Shape: Variable (round to slightly elongated)
 

 Flavour: Balanced, suitable for fresh use or cooking


 Harvest period:
 

 Typically from July onwards, depending on conditions


 Additional notes:
 

 Leaves may appear slightly unusual in shape, which is normal for this variety
 

 Allow fruits to fully ripen on the plant for best flavour
